question: Should `plugin.approval.cancel` plus nullable `plugin.approval.resolved.decision` become the supported plugin approval cancellation contract, and must every abort-aware waiter adopt it before this PR can merge?
rationale: This changes a public gateway/plugin approval contract and a partial implementation would leave the linked stale-approval bug present in sibling approval paths.

options.title: Complete the cancellation contract before merge
options.body: Require the PR to update every abort-aware plugin approval waiter, align SDK/docs/tests for nullable resolved events, and then provide real behavior proof.

options.title: Accept the narrow fix knowingly
options.body: Maintainers can land only the `before_tool_call` path, but the linked issue should remain open or be narrowed because sibling waiters would still be able to leave stale approvals.

options.title: Pause the API change
options.body: Hold or close the PR until maintainers decide whether nullable resolved events are the permanent plugin approval contract.

recommendation.title: Complete the cancellation contract before merge
recommendation.body: Require the PR to update every abort-aware plugin approval waiter, align SDK/docs/tests for nullable resolved events, and then provide real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and merged the async requireApproval/plugin approval surface this bug follows from, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the contract decision.
